prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic 1:1 avant-garde Nike tennis fashion advertisement in a crisp white studio with a reflective court-like floor. Feature a poised adult female tennis athlete with a feminine silhouette, natural skin texture, dark ponytail, and focused confident expression. She wears a fitted white Nike tennis dress with clean athletic coverage, white visor, white Nike socks, white Nike tennis shoes, and a simple wristband. Seat her casually on the strings of an oversized chrome Nike Vapor tennis racket positioned like a suspended lounge, one knee raised, legs in a dynamic athletic line, one arm resting along the frame. Place giant bold PRECISION typography behind her and accurate product copy ENGINEERED FOR EXACTITUDE. DESIGNED FOR DOMINANCE. MADE TO WIN. plus VAPOR — THE ART OF ACCURACY. Use clean cinematic lighting, chrome highlights, soft flattering illumination, realistic court reflections, and no extra text or watermark.
